finding: A successful member save or invitation create response arriving late closed a changed/reopened editor and discarded a new draft.

assertions: Same member edited after submission remains open
Saving member A must not close member B editor
Changed invitation draft survives first link result
Reopened invitation draft survives first link result
red.evidenceType: Real loopback API write succeeded; only response delivery held; no mocked business success

excludedDiagnosticRun.reason: Three initial failures were exact-label selectors, corrected before formal red. One genuine member-cross-editor failure; not counted as four defects.

fix: Each editor opening has its own session counter; every edited field increments a draft revision.
Success closes/clears only the exact submitted opening and unchanged draft.
Invitation result keeps the one-time URL and displays the submitted email; later invitation draft stays intact.

actualStateAssertions: Member nickname/role/creditLimit after first and second writes
Different members retain independently saved nicknames
First and second invitation email/role persisted with distinct one-time URLs
Normal unchanged save/create closes its own editor

isolation: Synthetic accounts, temp SQLite and media, loopback-only local SMTP; no formal DB or external paid service
validationScope: 本报告仅记录所列阶段局部验证；不得与其它阶段或最终全量数量相加，不代表最终冻结源码的完整浏览器验收已完成。
pathBase: 所有证据路径均相对仓库根目录。
